# hostinger_vps_templates (Data Source)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) The list of available VPS operating system templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).


<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Template description.
- `documentation` (String) Link to the official operating system documentation.
- `id` (Number) Template ID.
- `name` (String) Template name.
